metadata.title: Mats Tyldum – CTO at Outlet Group
metadata.description: Mats Tyldum is CTO at Outlet Group in Bergen, Norway. Technology leader with a developer background. CV, experience and skills.
metadata.keywords: Mats Tyldum, CTO, technology leader, developer, Bergen, Outlet Group

hero.name: Mats Tyldum
hero.description: I lead technology at Outlet Group and still write code. A developer at heart, with a background from banking and consulting. The code is on <github>GitHub</github>, and I'm happy to chat on <linkedin>LinkedIn</linkedin>.

items.name: ferjetider.fyi
items.description: Trip planner for the ferries between Stavanger and Bergen. Pulls departures, delays and cancellations from Entur, and works out which ferry you can catch on the next crossing.

cv.name: Mats Tyldum
cv.title: Mats Tyldum – CV
cv.subtitle: CTO, Outlet Group
cv.summary: Technology leader with a developer background. Enjoy combining strategy, leadership, and technical work.

items.description: Leading technology strategy, product development, and technical execution across Outlet Group.
highlights: Every developer uses Claude Code, and agents take simple issues all the way to a finished PR.

items.description: Led a team of 10 responsible for developing and maintaining the bank's payment services.
highlights: Delivered «the red button» in the fraud project «Et steg foran»: it blocks the account and BankID within seconds of an identity theft alert.
Drove technical upgrades and the retirement of legacy systems in preparation for the merger of Sparebanken Vest and Sparebanken Sør.

items.description: Team lead and developer in a team responsible for the bank's payment services.
Developer. Consulting engagement at Equinor, 2021-2022. Part-time alongside studies, 2019-2021
Developed a solution for extracting, structuring, and visualizing well data.
Teaching assistant in object-oriented programming, computer architecture, and algorithms & data structures.
Specialization in reservoir technology. Exchange semester at the University of Adelaide, fall 2016.
